Gbe languages are a group of languages spoken in the Volta basin that share a unique feature called the serial verb construction. This construction allows two or more verbs to be juxtaposed in one clause, sharing the same subject and lacking conjunctive markings, resulting in a meaning that expresses the consecutive or simultaneous aspect of the actions of the verbs.
